description: This source file defines a REST exception handler class 'ApiExceptionHandler' in a Spring Boot project. It maps internal exceptions like NoSuchElementException and ErrorResponseException to HTTP error responses using Spring's ProblemDetail class, providing a centralized way to handle errors and produce stable HTTP error messages.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A REST controller advice class for handling exceptions globally in a Spring Boot application, converting exceptions into standardized HTTP error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException, returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException, logging the error and returning the embedded ProblemDetail.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, logs the error, and returns a 500 Internal Server Error response.
